Then the run holds status "TIMED_OUT" and is not retried for that event

  Scenario: AC10 A role without the right is refused (story criterion for X7)
    Given role "RW-CASEOWN" calls the evaluation read
    When the platform guard checks the call
    Then the call is refused with status 403 and message "MSG-P4-002"

  Scenario: AC11 A consumed contract misses its budget (story criterion for X8)
    Given a consumed contract of section 12.2 does not answer inside its 2 s budget
    When the agent runs
    Then the run holds status "TOOL_UNAVAILABLE" and fallback true, no proposal is raised for the case and event, the failure is counted on the run, and the run is not retried for that event

  Scenario: AC12 The rule package is missing or fails its checksum (story criterion for X9)
    Given the rwb-decision registry answers no rule package version for R-DEV-02 to R-DEV-06, or the checksum of the fetched package does not verify against the kit
    When the agent runs
    Then the run holds status "TOOL_UNAVAILABLE" and fallback true, the reason names the package, the proposal keeps no owner role, and nothing is written outside "rwb_agent"

  Scenario: AC13 The run writes six tables only (story criterion for BR8)
    Given a screening run is recorded for a case
    When the run is written
    Then the run writes only the six tables of section 12.7 in "rwb_agent" and the review count comes from migration "V10_005__evaluation_review_count.sql"

  Scenario: AC14 The code list comes from the reference-data contract (story criterion for BR9)
    Given the rwb-case reference-data contract mock returns the codes X1 to X7 of LOV-DEVIATION
    Given the model stub returns code "X9"
    When the guardrail runs
    Then code "X9" is refused and never proposed, and the codes are read through the contract and not from a table

  Scenario: AC15 The events carry no personal data (story criterion for BR10)
    Given case "RW-2026-000402" has one proposal of code X4
    When the run state change commits
    Then the outbox holds the run facts and the proposal as CloudEvents 1.0 messages on "rwb.agent.events.v1", keyed by the case ID, in the same transaction, and no field classed as personal data is carried
